<!--
  The application CV for vacancy 2026-JRC.B.2-SVQ-FGIV-003067 — Economic Analyst, tax
  modelling, Fiscal Policy Analysis Unit, JRC Seville.

  It is cv-full.qmd with one change: the About paragraph is the profile tagged
  `in: [JRC-tax-2026]` in ../_cv.yml rather than the generic `in: [full]` one. Every
  other section is the full CV, entry for entry, so a correction to the record lands
  here as well. Like its siblings it states no fact about the person.

  The file is named for the PDF it becomes, Bukin-cv-JRC-tax-2026.pdf: that PDF goes
  out as an attachment as it is, so the source carries the name the attachment should.

  It is built by every render, like its siblings, and lands in ../_site/cv/. It is not
  published: the deploy step in ../.github/workflows/publish.yml deletes every PDF in
  _site/cv/ except cv-full.pdf and cv-short.pdf before uploading the site. It cannot
  be kept out of the render instead — a file excluded from `project: render:` is
  rendered outside the project when named, and loses the cv and pubs shortcodes.
-->
